name: Jindal Steel Ltd
title: Jindal Steel Ltd - 532286 - TRANSCRIPT OF EARNINGS CONFERENCE CALL HELD ON MAY 2, 2026

read.thesis: Capacity ramp to 15.6 Mt with capex program essentially finished; FY27 guide 11–11.5 Mt production, Q4 ASP up ₹4,743/t sequentially, but value-added mix fell and Australia written down ₹1,433 cr.

utilisation.quote: our primary goal is first to achieve capacity utilization

capex.quote: We more or less finished our capex program. Our focus is on sweating the assets and getting returns out of them.

triggers.label: Capex program essentially complete
triggers.quote: We more or less finished our capex program. Our focus is on sweating the assets

triggers.label: ASP up ₹4,743/t QoQ
triggers.quote: The blended ASP has increased by INR 4,743 per tonne on a sequential basis.

triggers.label: FY27 production 11–11.5 Mt
triggers.quote: our production plan for FY 27 is 11 million to 11.5 million tonnes and sales between 10.5 million to 11 million tonnes

triggers.label: Coking coal +$20–25/t in Q1
triggers.quote: For Q1FY27, we expect coking coal prices to increase by $20 to $25 per tonne sequentially.

triggers.label: Value-added mix down to ~61% from 66%
triggers.quote: value added product share has come down to around 61% from 66% QoQ

guidance.quote: our production plan for FY 27 is 11 million to 11.5 million tonnes
sales between 10.5 million to 11 million tonnes
we will be allocating INR 7,500 crores to INR 10,000 crores to our capital expansion programs or sustenance capex
we expect leverage metrics to normalize by Q2FY27
Flat sales will increase in times to come and move towards 70% odd as we move ahead.

red_flags.label: Repeated refusal to give EBITDA/revenue guidance
red_flags.quote: EBITDA is a function of several things, a lot of which includes raw material and the pricing, which remains outside our control.

red_flags.label: Value-added mix declining QoQ
red_flags.quote: value added product share has come down to around 61% from 66% QoQ

evasions.quote: EBITDA is a function of several things, a lot of which includes raw material and the pricing, which remains outside our control.
revenue is a function of a lot of other things. So, we will stick with that for the time being.
I think predicting the market will be difficult.
